findings.text: Stub: cancelSocketCoverSearches documented as 'Cancel all cover searches associated with a socket (called on disconnect)' but body only logs 'any active searches will timeout' — unfinished-as-done; disconnects leave authenticated users' external cover-search fetches running instead of aborting; CoverSearchManager's activeSearches map could trivially support it.
socket.io cors origin: '*' for all clients; mitigated by token-based auth (no cookies) but over-permissive.
Re-authenticating an authenticated socket to a DIFFERENT user is permitted with only a warning log; client.user silently replaced mid-connection.
Dead/odd code: socket.sheepClient = this.clients[socket.id] assigned on every connection, no other usage in the codebase.

Floating promise: #log returns the async #logToFileAndListeners promise no call site awaits or catches — an error above LogManager would be unhandled rejection; fragile stack regex for the source getter.
Mild bloat: singleton mixes bus routing/auth with ~100 lines of cover-search streaming concerns; 'Events for testing' handlers (message_all_users, ping) live in production code.
